stem:
Sonia cuts a paper square into four congruent right triangles and rearranges those same pieces into one larger triangle with no gaps and no overlaps.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The larger triangle has the same total area as the original square.
Report the words same area as the answer and stop.
The new outline produces the piece areas, so start from the large triangle and invent four new piece sizes.
Find the square's perimeter by adding the outer edge lengths of the large triangle.

teacher.key_rationale: Rearranging the same pieces without gaps or overlaps keeps total area. Naming the phrase alone, inventing new piece sizes from the outline, or switching to perimeter all miss that conservation.
